module.purpose: Implements the browser-extension background middleware that bridges Redux DevTools state, content scripts, inspected pages, and monitor panels through Chrome runtime ports and messages.
module.summary: This module coordinates tab and DevTools monitor connections, routes serialized state and user actions between Redux and extension contexts, handles persisted instances, forwards reducer errors, opens DevTools windows, and works around Chrome message-size limits by splitting oversized state updates into chunks. It also registers Chrome runtime listeners and exposes Redux middleware for lifted actions and persistence toggling.
module.businessContext: Supports browser-based Redux DevTools monitoring across inspected tabs and DevTools panels. Failure breaks state synchronization, persistence restoration, monitor connectivity, and DevTools error reporting.

detail.name: messaging
detail.signature: function messaging<S, A extends Action<string>>(request: BackgroundStoreMessage<S, A>, sender: chrome.runtime.MessageSender)
postconditions: The message-specific side effect is performed, or the message is ignored when no tab ID can be resolved.
For ordinary non-control messages, an UPDATE_STATE action is dispatched and then forwarded to monitors unless the message is a split start or split chunk.
invariants: A truthy sender frameId is appended to the resolved tab ID using '-' before message routing.
Messages with an instanceId use a composite instance identifier of the form `${tabId}/${request.instanceId}` for dispatched state updates.
Split message chunks are accumulated per composite tab/instance key and removed after the final split message is assembled.
edgeCases: If getId(sender) returns a falsy value, the function returns without dispatching, broadcasting, opening a page, or creating a notification.
A STOP message dispatches DISCONNECTED only when the store has no instance connections; otherwise it returns without dispatching.
An OPEN message uses 'devtools-window' by default and maps 'remote' or 'window' positions to the corresponding 'devtools-' position.
An ERROR message with a payload is forwarded to monitors; without a payload and without a message it is ignored.
An ERROR message with a message creates the 'app-error' notification, using reducer error information when available.
A split 'start' message stores the initial split message and returns; a split 'chunk' message appends its chunk and returns; the terminal split message dispatches the reconstructed request.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Messages lacking a resolvable tab ID or an ERROR message lacking both payload and message are ignored.

For a content-script connection, INIT_INSTANCE and RELAY messages are handled according to their message contracts.

A monitor connection whose current instance is default does not send an initial UPDATE_STATE message.
A monitor connection with a non-default current instance sends an UPDATE_STATE message with actionsById and computedStates serialized and committedState represented as a boolean.
